articles.title: Applying FSRS Spaced Repetition to Software Engineering Knowledge
articles.description: Explore how to use the FSRS algorithm for software engineering knowledge. Learn how an evidence-gated learning loop moves spaced repetition beyond rote memorization to systemic understanding.

articles.title: Designing Useful Guest-Mode Technical Learning
articles.description: Learn how to build a robust guest mode for technical learning platforms that persists complex state and transitions seamlessly to authenticated accounts.

articles.title: How a Socratic coding assistant should respond to learners
articles.description: An AI shouldn't just hand out code. Learn why Socratic AI coding assistants must probe understanding, withhold direct solutions, and enforce the Feynman Gate to build actual mastery.

articles.title: How to Turn a Failed Coding Interview Into a Learning Plan
articles.description: Failed a coding interview? Don't panic. Learn how to extract signal from rejection, diagnose the root cause, and build an evidence-backed learning plan.

articles.title: Recognition vs Causal Understanding in Technical Study
articles.description: Explore the gap between recognition memory and causal understanding in software engineering study, and how evidence-gated loops build durable mastery.

articles.title: What Counts as Evidence of Mastery in Software Engineering?
articles.description: Explore why completed tutorials aren't enough and how to build verifiable evidence of engineering mastery through working artifacts, explain-backs, and tradeoff analysis.

articles.title: Why technical learning needs an inspectable artifact
articles.description: Passive technical learning creates the illusion of competence. Discover why true engineering mastery requires inspectable artifacts, causal explanations, and rigorous evidence loops.
